secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → API). Placeholder lets the app boot; real value needed for data/auth to work.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon/public key (Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → API). Placeholder lets the app boot; real value needed for data/auth to work.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service-role key, server-only (Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → API). Placeholder lets the app boot; real value needed for server routes/admin actions.
